title: Quantification of Microscopy-Based Bead Assay Using Cellpose
author: Elisabeth Holzer

steps.title: Segment Beads Using Cellpose
steps.instruction: Separate multichannel input images into individual TIFF files for each channel and process them using Cellpose for segmentation.

steps.title: Reassemble Multichannel Images
steps.instruction: Reassemble the labeled outputs from Cellpose back into multichannel images.

steps.title: Generate Line Profiles for Quantification
steps.instruction: Fit circular regions of interest (ROIs) to the segmented beads and draw radial line profiles to capture fluorescence intensity from the bead center to the surrounding inter-bead space.

substeps.instruction: Draw 20 line profiles from each bead center, extending radially beyond the ROI boundary.
Use a combined ROI encompassing all segmented beads to limit line profile extension and avoid overlap with neighboring beads.

steps.title: Perform Quality Control
steps.instruction: Manually inspect all AI-generated segmentations and line profiles.

steps.title: Calculate Fluorescence Intensity
steps.instruction: Calculate the mean fluorescence intensity and standard deviation for each bead based on its 20 line profiles.

steps.title: Filter Outliers
steps.instruction: Exclude or manually review beads where the standard deviation is equal to or exceeds 50% of the mean value.

steps.title: Normalize and Analyze Data
steps.instruction: Normalize and analyze the fluorescence data for experimental comparison.

substeps.instruction: Calculate relative intensities by normalizing each bead's mean intensity to the average bead intensity of the control condition.
Plot and analyze final data using GraphPad PRISM for statistical evaluation.
